preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The number of caves is between 3 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of tunnels is between n and the maximum possible number of tunnels, which is either (n * (n - 1)) / 2 or 2000, whichever is smaller.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= a_i <= 10^9 for all i in range(2, n+1)
preconditions.description: The power required to beat the monster in each cave is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= b_i <= 10^9 for all i in range(2, n+1)
preconditions.description: The power increase after beating the monster in each cave is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= u_i, v_i <= n and u_i != v_i for all i in range(m)
preconditions.description: The caves connected by each tunnel are distinct and within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: Each cave can be reached from any other cave by moving via tunnels
preconditions.description: The graph formed by caves and tunnels is connected.

preconditions.expression: At least two tunnels come out of every cave
preconditions.description: Each cave has at least two outgoing tunnels.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the smallest possible power the hero must start the level with to beat all the monsters and pass the level.
